name: protein-drug-design
description: 蛋白质药物设计与科研全链路技能插件（43 项）：计算主线（序列/结构分析、AF3 批量预测、MD 模拟、结合能）+ 文献/构思/实验设计/统计/学术写作/论文审查/PPT视频配图 + nature-skills 全套（中英对照精读、PaperCard、CNS 引文核实、专利草稿、实验日志等）。
descriptionEn: Full-chain protein drug design & research skill plugin (43 skills): computation mainline (sequence/structure analysis, AF3 batch prediction, MD simulation, binding energy) + literature/ideation/experiment-design/statistics/academic-writing/manuscript-review/presentation + the complete nature-skills suite (bilingual paper readers, PaperCards, CNS citation verification, patent drafting, experiment logging, and more).
